description:
Returns the details of one tender notice by its uid: title, contracting authority (name, address, email, phone, website), all dates, CPV/NUTS codes, AI summaries (short, medium, long, plain language), key deliverables, risk flags, eligibility summary and the link to the original portal. Intended for requests where the user asks about one specific tender, e.g. its deadline, contact or scope. Input: the uid from search_tenders or list_tenders results (format source:id, e.g. bkm:675fa09d-…, ted:427373-2026, bund:eVergabe/888110). The response also contains the numeric notice_id; the list of procurement documents, the AI-structured sections and the Q&A are returned by get_tender_documents. Limits: 30 requests per 10 minutes, 200 per day per IP.

Example user questions: "Zeig mir Details zur Ausschreibung bkm:675fa09d-5152-46c5-9967-ed104d16276b"; "Was sind Frist und Vergabestelle für diese Bekanntmachung?"; "Welche Unterlagen und Fristen hat die Ausschreibung XYZ?"; "Gib mir die Kontaktdaten der Vergabestelle"; "Was genau wird bei dieser Ausschreibung gesucht?"

uid.description: Stable cross-portal UID in the form 'source:id'. Taken directly from the uid field in search_tenders or list_tenders results. Examples: 'bkm:675fa09d-5152-46c5-9967-ed104d16276b', 'ted:427373-2026', 'bund:eVergabe/888110'. URL-encode the colon if needed.

name: get_tender
title: Ausschreibung abrufen
